name: mc_protect
title: Protected regions
description:
Adds, lists and removes protected regions: named, persistent boxes that mc_build, mc_repair and mc_restore refuse to write into (mode "deny") or only warn about (mode "warn") unless a call names the region in `override`.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants a finished or hand-built area kept safe from later agent edits ("don't touch the dock", "this module is approved"); before working near such an area, list regions with `touches` to see what is protected.

WHEN NOT TO USE: as server-wide griefing protection - players, other plugins and mc_command are not checked. To undo changes (mc_restore). Do not remove a region or pass `override` only to get a rejected build through; ask the user first.

PARAMETERS: action "add": name (1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_'), from/to inclusive corners [x,y,z], optional world (default world), note (at most 200 characters) and mode "deny" (default) or "warn". Names are unique; remove a region before redefining it. action "list": optional world and touches:{from,to} (default world when touches is given). action "remove": name; only its creator, an operator or the console/MCP token may remove it.

SIDE EFFECTS: add/remove rewrite plugins/Ashlar/protected.json atomically; no world changes. A deny overlap rejects the writing call before any snapshot or write and names the region, overlapping target-cell count and bounds; mc_plan and dryRun report overlaps without rejecting. Overrides are logged. Checks cover each call's write targets, not physics or connection updates outside them.

name.description: Region name; required for add and remove.

world.description: add/list: world name; defaults to the server's default world.

mode.description: add: deny rejects writing calls; warn lets them write with a warning.

note.description: add: why the area is protected; shown in rejections and warnings.

touches.description: list: only regions intersecting this box.
